map.本工具用于检测（硬度/磨耗/寿命）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (hardness / abrasion / life) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：钢质磨料三项检测判定（硬度/磨耗/寿命）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Steel Abrasive (Hardness / Abrasion / Life)
map.钢磨料自检：按硬度（HRC）、磨耗量、使用寿命三项判定: Steel-abrasive self-check: judge by three items — hardness (HRC), abrasion loss, service life
map.抛丸效率：硬度与磨耗关系清理能力与消耗: Blasting efficiency: hardness and abrasion relate to cleaning ability and consumption
map.逐项判定：硬度 58~65HRC、磨耗量≤0.05g、使用寿命≥1000h；三项: Item-by-item: hardness 58~65 HRC, abrasion loss ≤ 0.05 g, service life ≥ 1000 h; all three satisfied = pass. Hardness sets cleaning force; abrasion loss sets self-consumption.
map.硬度 60HRC（区间✓）、磨耗 0.03g（≤0.05 ✓）、寿命 1200h: Hardness 60 HRC (range ✓), abrasion 0.03 g (≤0.05 ✓), life 1200 h (≥1000 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If abrasion rises to 0.08 g it fails, self-consumption too fast.
map.硬度 58~65HRC 为何是区间？: Why is hardness 58~65 HRC a range?
map.过高易碎裂、过低清理力不足；58~65HRC 为铸钢/钢丝切丸常用工作硬度窗口，: Too high easily cracks; too low insufficient cleaning force. 58~65 HRC is the common working-hardness window for cast-steel/wire-cut shot — balance toughness and wear.
map.标准抛丸循环后称量磨料质量损失；超 0.05g 表示破碎率高、消耗快、成本高，须: Weigh the abrasive mass loss after a standard blasting cycle; over 0.05 g means high breakage rate, fast consumption, high cost — replace material or adjust process.
map.硬度测试需标准试块，测试前需打磨表面: Hardness testing requires a standard block; surface must be polished before testing
map.磨损试验需标准砂轮和载荷参数: Wear tests require a standard grinding wheel and load parameters
map.关于「检测（硬度/磨耗/寿命）服务」: About the Hardness / Abrasion / Life Testing Service
